# `mise vars unset`

- **Usage:** `mise vars unset [NAME]…`
- **Aliases:** `rm`, `remove`
- **Effect:** modifies state
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/vars/unset.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/vars/unset.rs)

Forget saved answers so they are asked for again

Edits `$MISE_STATE_DIR/vars.toml`; no config is loaded. The next
`mise vars prompt` or `mise bootstrap --prompt-vars` asks again.

## Arguments
- **`[NAME]…`** — The vars whose answers to forget

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Be asked for git_name again

```
mise vars unset git_name
```
